info.title: MTM-APP
info.description: API for managing patient encounters, admissions, and exams.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of prescribed procedures/exams (PRESCR_PROCEDIMENTO) across all encounters of a given patient, whose prescription was liberated within a date range, optionally filtered by exam type, specialty and exam name. Same known `FLOOR(total/pageSize + 1)` pagination caveat as `GetExameListByPeriodo`.

get.summary: Retrieves a single patient encounter (ATENDIMENTO_PACIENTE) by its identifier, joined with patient identification/contact data and counters of evolutions, prescriptions, exams and discharge summary. Always responds with HTTP 200: when the encounter is not found, the response body is an empty object `{}` (a gateway in front of SmartLink discards the response body on any non-2xx status, so 404 cannot be used).

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of patients (PESSOA_FISICA) who currently have an active, non-cancelled encounter with at least one unit passage, optionally filtered by encounter type, name, age range, sex, care unit sector classification and responsible physician. get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of prescribed procedures/exams (PRESCR_PROCEDIMENTO), across all patients, whose prescription was liberated within a date range, optionally filtered by specialty. Only rows with a prescribed and non-suspended/non-cancelled procedure are returned; imaging-type procedures (`Tipo = IMG`) are additionally restricted to a fixed list of sectors per establishment, hardcoded in the underlying query. **Known pagination caveat:** `TotalPages` is computed as `FLOOR(total/pageSize + 1)`, which returns one extra (phantom, empty) page when `total` is an exact multiple of `pageSize`.

get.summary: Retrieves a single patient (PESSOA_FISICA) by identifier, joined with contact data, allergy/disease/continuous-medication summaries, the latest encounter data and the patient classifications (PESSOA_CLASSIF). Always responds with HTTP 200: when the patient is not found, the response body is an empty object `{}` (same decision as GetAtendimentoById). Because of an unfiltered LEFT JOIN with PESSOA_CLASSIF, a patient with N classifications returns N underlying rows, collapsed by this endpoint into a single object with a `classificacoes` array — do not take the first row directly, or classifications would be silently dropped.
